description: This PHP source file is a unit test class for the ClientRepository component within an OAuth module of the OrangeHRM project. It contains setup code and test methods to verify client entity retrieval and validation logic.

classes.name: ClientRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the OAuth ClientRepository's retrieval and validation functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the testing environment by loading fixture data into the database.

methods.name: testGetClientEntity
methods.description: Tests retrieval of client entities by ID and verifies their properties, including handling of non-existent or disabled clients.

methods.name: testValidateClient
methods.description: Tests validation of clients with various IDs, secrets, and grant types, verifying correct validation logic for active, disabled, or non-existent clients.
